collections.name: Sample Intake & Initial Assessment
collections.description: Establish sample identity, investigation context, and the next analysis steps.

tasks.name: Record provenance and investigation questions
tasks.description: Document where the sample came from, relevant context, and the questions this investigation should answer.

tasks.name: Verify file type and architecture
tasks.description: Determine the actual file format, platform, architecture, and runtime requirements rather than relying on the filename.

tasks.name: Record hashes and metadata
tasks.description: Record cryptographic hashes and relevant metadata using the existing Case fields and indicator conventions.

tasks.name: Review existing intelligence
tasks.description: Review authorized internal and external information, recording useful references and the limits of any identification.

tasks.name: Identify related samples and Cases
tasks.description: Check for existing Cases, matching indicators, or related artifacts and document supported relationships.

tasks.name: Document initial assessment and next steps
tasks.description: Summarize preliminary findings, uncertainties, and the additional task collections or analysis needed.

collections.name: Basic Static Analysis
collections.description: Examine file structure and static artifacts to guide further investigation.

tasks.name: Review strings and embedded resources
tasks.description: Identify useful strings, resources, paths, commands, and embedded artifacts, recording their context.

tasks.name: Examine imports, exports, and dependencies
tasks.description: Review available interfaces and dependencies for clues about functionality and execution requirements.

tasks.name: Inspect file structure and anomalies
tasks.description: Examine relevant sections, headers, overlays, or structural irregularities and document significant findings.

tasks.name: Assess packing and obfuscation
tasks.description: Identify evidence of packing, encryption, or obfuscation and explain how it limits static analysis.

tasks.name: Review capability and signature results
tasks.description: Review available tool results and identify supporting evidence rather than accepting labels as conclusions.

tasks.name: Record findings requiring validation
tasks.description: List candidate behaviors and indicators that need confirmation through code review or controlled execution.

collections.name: Controlled Dynamic Analysis
collections.description: Observe execution in an appropriate isolated analysis environment and document the resulting evidence.

tasks.name: Document execution requirements and lab configuration
tasks.description: Record the relevant operating system, arguments, dependencies, network configuration, and analysis conditions.

tasks.name: Execute the sample in the analysis environment
tasks.description: Run the sample using the approved isolated workflow and retain relevant execution details.

tasks.name: Confirm execution succeeded
tasks.description: Determine whether meaningful sample execution occurred and document failures, missing conditions, or evasion concerns.

tasks.name: Review process and system activity
tasks.description: Examine process, filesystem, registry, service, or equivalent system activity supported by the environment.

tasks.name: Collect dropped files and network artifacts
tasks.description: Preserve relevant output files, logs, captures, and extracted artifacts and link them to the Case.

tasks.name: Document limitations and unanswered questions
tasks.description: Explain what the execution did and did not establish and identify follow-up work.

collections.name: Windows PE Analysis
collections.description: Investigate Windows executable structure, loading behavior, and host artifacts.

tasks.name: Inspect PE headers and resources
tasks.description: Review architecture, sections, metadata, and resources and record relevant anomalies.

tasks.name: Review imports, exports, and TLS callbacks
tasks.description: Identify interfaces and initialization paths that warrant further examination.

tasks.name: Determine loading and execution requirements
tasks.description: Establish whether the sample requires a loader, export invocation, arguments, privileges, or other dependencies.

tasks.name: Examine persistence and system changes
tasks.description: Investigate supported persistence mechanisms and relevant filesystem, registry, service, or scheduled-task changes.

tasks.name: Investigate process injection if indicated
tasks.description: Examine evidence of injection or related process manipulation where present, recording the basis for the conclusion.

tasks.name: Record Windows-specific artifacts
tasks.description: Document useful host artifacts, execution conditions, and detection opportunities with supporting evidence.

collections.name: Linux ELF Analysis
collections.description: Investigate Linux executable structure, runtime behavior, and host artifacts.

tasks.name: Inspect ELF headers and architecture
tasks.description: Review architecture, sections, segments, interpreter, and relevant structural characteristics.

tasks.name: Review symbols and dependencies
tasks.description: Examine available symbols, imported functions, linked libraries, and runtime dependencies.

tasks.name: Trace startup and configuration loading
tasks.description: Identify initialization paths, arguments, environment use, and configuration sources.

tasks.name: Examine filesystem and process behavior
tasks.description: Review relevant file access, process execution, permissions, and system interactions.

tasks.name: Investigate persistence mechanisms
tasks.description: Examine applicable startup scripts, service definitions, scheduled jobs, or other persistence evidence.

tasks.name: Review syscall and behavioral evidence
tasks.description: Correlate available syscall traces, sandbox results, or Tracee output with code findings and document limitations.

collections.name: Script & Obfuscated Code Analysis
collections.description: Recover script logic and analyze staged or obfuscated code while preserving the original artifacts.

tasks.name: Identify language and runtime
tasks.description: Determine the scripting language, runtime, entry point, and execution requirements.

tasks.name: Preserve the original artifact
tasks.description: Retain the original sample and identify derived versions so transformations remain traceable.

tasks.name: Decode obfuscation layers
tasks.description: Recover encoded or obfuscated content without unintentionally executing it and document the transformation steps.

tasks.name: Reconstruct control flow
tasks.description: Identify important branches, execution triggers, commands, and function relationships.

tasks.name: Identify additional stages
tasks.description: Extract or document embedded and downloaded payloads, including their provenance and execution relationships.

tasks.name: Document behavior and indicators
tasks.description: Record supported behavior, useful indicators, and remaining uncertainty with references to the recovered code.

collections.name: Network & C2 Analysis
collections.description: Characterize network communication and distinguish candidate infrastructure from observed activity.

tasks.name: Identify endpoints and protocols
tasks.description: Record relevant destinations, ports, protocols, and configuration sources with their context.

tasks.name: Distinguish candidate and observed destinations
tasks.description: Separate values found in code or configuration from destinations actually used during observed execution.

tasks.name: Review network evidence
tasks.description: Examine available packet captures, sandbox logs, or other network records and retain supporting evidence.

tasks.name: Characterize communication behavior
tasks.description: Document connection patterns, beaconing, message structure, and command handling where supported.

tasks.name: Examine encoding and encryption
tasks.description: Identify relevant communication transformations and explain what can be established from the available evidence.

tasks.name: Document detection opportunities and limitations
tasks.description: Record useful network characteristics, possible benign overlap, and confidence limits.

collections.name: Configuration Extraction
collections.description: Recover malware configuration and document a repeatable, evidence-based extraction process.

tasks.name: Locate configuration storage and loading
tasks.description: Identify where configuration is stored and how the sample accesses it.

tasks.name: Analyze decoding or decryption
tasks.description: Determine transformations required to recover configuration and retain supporting code references.

tasks.name: Extract and label configuration fields
tasks.description: Recover available values and distinguish established field meanings from tentative interpretations.

tasks.name: Validate extracted configuration
tasks.description: Compare recovered values with code paths or observed behavior and record inconsistencies.

tasks.name: Preserve extraction evidence
tasks.description: Attach relevant output, scripts, offsets, or notes needed to understand the extraction.

tasks.name: Document repeatable extraction steps
tasks.description: Explain how another analyst can reproduce the result and identify known sample or version limitations.

collections.name: Indicator Validation & Curation
collections.description: Prepare contextualized indicators suitable for analysis, reporting, and downstream use.

tasks.name: Consolidate extracted indicators
tasks.description: Gather relevant indicators from analysis artifacts while preserving their source and context.

tasks.name: Normalize types and values
tasks.description: Apply existing indicator conventions and verify appropriate formatting without changing meaningful values.

tasks.name: Remove duplicate indicators
tasks.description: Consolidate duplicate entries while retaining useful evidence and context.

tasks.name: Review benign and shared infrastructure
tasks.description: Identify values with likely benign or shared use and document implications for detection.

tasks.name: Add context and provenance
tasks.description: Explain how each useful indicator relates to the sample or observed behavior.

tasks.name: Separate observed and unverified indicators
tasks.description: Clearly distinguish validated observations from candidates that have not been confirmed.

collections.name: Report & MIP Delivery Review
collections.description: Review analytical claims and verify the final report and MIP deliverables.

tasks.name: Complete the report sections
tasks.description: Address the relevant report sections and clearly document findings, limitations, and unresolved questions.

tasks.name: Verify claims against evidence
tasks.description: Check that substantive conclusions are supported and that inference is distinguished from observation.

tasks.name: Review indicators and references
tasks.description: Confirm indicator quality, context, and reference accuracy.

tasks.name: Review mappings and detection content
tasks.description: Check applicable ATT&CK/MBC mappings and detection artifacts for supported claims and documented limitations.

tasks.name: Verify Standard and RAW package contents
tasks.description: Inspect package contents against the existing exporter rules and the intended recipient.

tasks.name: Check the exported deliverable
tasks.description: Generate and inspect the appropriate output to confirm required content is present and readable.
